description: A false-colour infrared satellite map of Benfeld, France, sourced from Spot 5 imagery at 2.5 m resolution. The base imagery displays healthy vegetation in red tones, bare soil or sparsely vegetated areas in grey/brown, and water bodies in dark blue/black. Overlaid on this imagery is a transparent turquoise polygon that delineates a mineral extraction site along a river. Within this delineated area, two land cover classification codes are labelled: "1310" is shown in a light blue box, located centrally within the primary extraction area. "3400" is shown in a yellow box, located to the south within the same turquoise-highlighted mineral extraction site, adjacent to a water feature. Fine blue lines denote surrounding land parcel or administrative boundaries.
